audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1-3 gave Kayle or Skill the window while every one of their captions says Teemo zones her off the wave and wins every extended trade; row 4 gave Teemo the level-6 window though its caption says you finally farm safely; row 5 gave Kayle the first-item row though Nashor's is also his spike.
audit.why: The Teemo-side mirror already reconciled this chart to Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Teemo, Skill, Teemo, Kayle, and the 48.4% win rate over 531 games supports Teemo owning most of it.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the mirror's reconciliation in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Level 6 (Divine Ascent range + Divine Judgment), Nashor's, and the level 11/16 window are the right spikes; his are the blind online and his own first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats the blind as switching off your whole kit and never states what still works through it, nor what Divine Judgment does to his damage profile.
audit.why: Blinding Dart blinds basic attacks — Starfire Spellblade rides an attack and is lost with it, but Radiant Blast is a spell and lands regardless. Divine Judgment's invulnerability erases damage over time outright, so Toxic Shot and mushroom ticks do nothing during it, and it can be cast on an ally at 900 range.
audit.corrected: Both facts added to mid, with Blinding Dart's flat 7s cooldown as the spacing rhythm.

audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank and costs 70-90 mana, which is now the stated spacing window.

edits.before: Nashor's plus your ranged form lets you out-trade his poison when you stick range, but a single blind still flips a sloppy fight — even window.
edits.after: His first item lands harder here: a 7-second Blinding Dart still blanks an auto-reliant Kayle, so his poison wins any trade where you drift inside 680.

edits.before: Level 6 is your breath of air: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with a small AoE wave, and R (Divine Judgment) grants a few seconds of full invulnerability, so now you can farm from distance and survive when he tries to all-in or his jungler shows. You still cannot stand in his blind, so space him — auto, step back, let the Blinding Dart cool, auto again. Pop R on a dive or your own commit to deny the kill, and start leaning on E's missing-health damage the moment your range out-reaches his poison.
edits.after: Level 6 is your breath of air: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with a small AoE wave, and R (Divine Judgment) grants a few seconds of full invulnerability — it erases Toxic Shot and mushroom ticks outright, and you can hand that to a poisoned ally at 900 range. You still cannot stand in his blind, so space him — auto, step back, let the flat 7-second Blinding Dart cool, auto again. The blind never touches Radiant Blast, so keep poking with Q while your autos are off.

edits.before: Blinds your autos. Fight when down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Blinds autos and your E on-hit, flat 7s — Q still lands through it.

notes: Blinding Dart is 7s at every rank. Radiant Blast is a spell and is unaffected by the blind — the page previously implied the blind shut off everything. Divine Judgment's invulnerability wipes damage over time, which is the cleanest answer to poison and shroom ticks and works on an ally at 900 range.
